first_red.interpretation: The direct file route defaults to display/original and the Studio access adapter maps that to preview. The initial script requested it immediately after original readiness, before preview was ready. Final Canvas access uses display/thumbnail and download/original and both succeeded. No direct-file request was observed from normal Canvas UI during readback.
